'''Veedo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a light armor vendor located in the [[Concourse Bazaar]] of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR" />
